macros.name: tempercolor
macros.doc: This library provides the command \tempercolor{Kelvin} that uses the CIE 1964 10-degree color matching function to convert a given temperature, in Kelvin (1000 K ≤ T ≤ 40000 K), to the respective correlated color.
